summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund, a non-traded Delaware business development company, filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 31,031,335 common shares for aggregate consideration of $769.0 million, priced at each class's August 31, 2026 NAV of $24.7808 per share. The shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2), Rule 506(b) and/or Regulation S, finalized September 22, 2026. The filing also declared monthly distributions of $0.20830 gross per share for September through December 2026, payable October 2026 through January 2027. No special-situation or strategic event is present; continuous NAV-based capital raising only.
